description: Where leveraged Bitcoin or Ethereum futures positions would be liquidated right now: CryptoKeyhole's live liquidation map, estimated by 0.5% price band from 15% below to 15% above the price, with the largest long and short clusters, the totals within 5% and the map's measured accuracy. Redrawn every five minutes. Covers BTC and ETH.
name: get_liquidation_map
title: Liquidation map
